label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: redirect URL at sendRedirect(redirect) resolves to oauth_state_+state session attribute value, where state=param from request.getParameter("state"). No state generation/validation visible - attacker can craft state parameter to retrieve arbitrary session-stored redirect URLs. The startsWith("/") check prevents open redirects but does not mitigate the root cause of unvalidated redirect source.

evidence.note: state from user param -> session key "oauth_state_"+state -> redirect retrieved from session -> sendRedirect
